description: Election Commission - L. A. M. S. Athukorala was selected as the member of the Dompe Pradeshiya Sabha, S. I. Kumara was selected as the member of the Nawalapitiya Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Dompe Pradeshiya Sabha and Nawalapitiya Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically addresses electoral processes, including the declaration of selected members to fill seats that became vacant due to specific circumstances (non-attendance of meetings and ceasing party membership). The content falls under election-related administrative matters rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganizations.
